rule_title: TTP 1136.001 - Hidden Local Account Created (Dollar Suffix)
description: Detects creation of a hidden local account using the dollar-sign suffix convention (e.g. backdoor$). Accounts ending with $ are omitted from net user output and most GUI user management tools, making them invisible to casual inspection. The 4720 TargetUserName ending in $ is the definitive signal regardless of the creation method.
